title: Frame-rate DPR governor and an idle render gate
summary: Half-second fps windows step `setPixelRatio` by `.25` (down under 45, up over 57, hold between) inside the probe's clamp (ceiling = probe DPR and pixel budget, floor `max(.5, cap / 2)`); the loop leaves the shared ticker `1.5 s` after the last scroll, pointer, wheel, touch or key input unless a transition or easing is busy, and stops on hidden tabs; `__governor.simulate(ms)` injects frame times; still field under reduced motion with the same governor and gate, one frame in the static tier
variants: Three.js: half-second fps windows step setPixelRatio by .25 inside the probe's clamp, loop off the shared ticker 1.5 s after the last input (this, default)
Target-fps tier object: per-tier DPR range and target fps instead of fixed 45 / 57 thresholds
R3F: <Canvas frameloop="demand"> with invalidate() on input for the gate, and setDpr from a PerformanceMonitor-style callback for the governor
